## 📋 Quality & Compliance Checklist
Please ensure your PR complies with the following:
- [ ] Written in clear, concise, idiomatic **English**.
- [ ] Follows the standardized section structure (`🎯 Why It Matters`, `✅ Verification Checklist`, `💡 Best Practices`, `🔧 Recommended Tools`, `📚 Additional Resources`).
- [ ] Code examples are tested, production-grade, and free of dangerous anti-patterns.
- [ ] Syntax highlighting tags are set for all code fences (`ts`, `py`, `go`, `yml`, `json`, `sql`, `bash`).
- [ ] All markdown links are verified and working.
- [ ] Updated the `*Last updated: YYYY-MM-DD*` timestamp in affected file(s).
- [ ] Added/updated entries in `CHANGELOG.md` if this represents a significant release update.
